principles: Regulator records establish accreditation or licensing state; they are evidence, not the primary discovery destination.
Operational contacts are enriched from institution-owned official channels or appropriate official public service directories.
Contact assignment uses exact normalized aliases only; fuzzy matching is prohibited.

Every matched contact is classified by contact_scope. entity_direct is institution/provider-specific; central_admissions_support is fallback support and must never be counted or labelled as institution-direct.
Contactability filters for phone, email, website, admissions and directions operate on institution-direct contacts unless a filter explicitly requests central support.
WhatsApp is exposed only when the source explicitly identifies a number as WhatsApp-capable.
Suspicious phone strings and invalid email-like strings are withheld rather than repaired by assumption.
Every contact enrichment retains source identity, observation date and verification class.
External regulator links are presented only in secondary provenance views; Sukuu Search keeps users on the local entity record for normal discovery workflows.

contact_scope_classes.entity_direct: Verified contact belongs to the institution/provider itself.
contact_scope_classes.central_admissions_support: Official fallback admissions/support contact associated with a category or central service. Not an institution-direct contact.
